bounds.scope: Existing transport call/deadline/cancel budgets also apply; caps do not reset per page, kind, region or project.

native_transport.methods: Constructed GET list/get endpoints only, no arbitrary URLs or payload methods
native_transport.session: Dedicated session; trust_env=False, auth=None, clear cookies, minimal Bearer/Accept/Accept-Encoding/quota headers
native_transport.credentials: Only acquired after exact kind/project/region/ID/cursor validation; uppercase/lowercase ADC headers accepted, no ambient auth
integrity: prepared response URL equals constructed request; no history/redirects
Content-Length required and verified against full bytes
strict UTF8/unique-key JSON; no nonfinite constants
bounded raw reads with remaining socket deadline where available
close responses and session on all paths
native_transport.privacy: No native configuration or error body enters generic transport cache; evidence contains exact operation ID, kind, scope, region and static status only, never literal URL/query/name/error text
native_transport.partial_pages: Native empty failedLocation/unreachable arrays accepted; nonempty or malformed arrays remain incomplete. Unknown page fields, duplicate resources/cursors and exceeded pages cannot yield complete collections.
native_transport.unsupported_transport: Chunked bodies without Content-Length remain conservative UNKNOWN; no actual network timing or OS egress isolation is certified.

detectors.redaction: scan_content _redact_values passes union of exact detected strings directly to redact_matches on metadata before serialization; recursively changed names/descriptions/labels/maps get unavailable field coverage. No raw matches are cached or returned.
detectors.triage: Opaque JobLiteralIdentity ties producer/check; derived canonical nativeResourceName is included in the same scan/redaction before retention.
detectors.merge: Shared process-keyed exact-value HMAC and deduplicate_secret_findings produce one hidden finding across tools/owners; no fuzzy/casefold or cross-process/cross-run guarantee.
detectors.failure: Missing engines/unsupported/incomplete configuration or any budget error remains UNKNOWN; negative only when both pinned engines finish.

tests.reused_shared_attribution: Independent root acceptance test asserts that each Dataflow item links its own full GET rather than the sibling GET. Earlier accepted review separately attributed two existing shared redaction tests; they were not rerun in this follow-up.
tests.intermediate_run_incident: An intermediate failed fixture run reached default HTTP with a fixed fake Bearer token and received 401 after root scheduling changed. No real credentials or job configuration payload were sent. The final fixture removed scheduling overrides, mocked requests.Session, and blocked Python socket/DNS access before collection; the final 50-test run and twelve-case export used that isolation. This does not attest OS-level subprocess egress isolation.
